facts.summary: Positive topline Phase 1 safety/PD results announced; no stated cause for drop · Phase 1 · SAB-142 in type 1 diabetes · not yet approved

evidence.summary: SAB BIO Announces Positive Topline Phase 1 Clinical Results with Potentially Disease-Modifying T1D Therapy SAB-142
evidence.primary_endpoint_met: The study met its primary objectives related to safety and pharmacodynamic activity enabling SAB-142 to advance to Phase 2b clinical development.
evidence.safety: SAB-142 was generally well-tolerated and demonstrated a favorable safety profile that supports the chronic dosing of SAB-142 in an ambulatory setting.
evidence.program_discontinued: SAB BIO plans to advance SAB-142 into a Phase 2b trial in 2025 to evaluate the therapeutic candidate in adult and pediatric patients with new-onset T1D.
